title: Exact Transversal Logical Groups of Quantum MDS–CSS Codes
description: Transversal gates implement encoded operations by tensor products of single-qudit unitaries. This preprint determines the exact projective transversal logical group for the quantum MDS–CSS codes associated with linear [2m,m,m+1]_q maximum distance separable codes over odd prime fields, allowing the one-qudit gate to depend on the coordinate. The classification reduces to the code conductor Cond(C,C⊥)={s∈F_q^(2m):s⋆C⊆C⊥}=(C^(⋆2))⊥. The half-rate MDS hypotheses force this space to have dimension zero or one. The exact logical group is F_q²⋊T in the zero-dimensional case and F_q²⋊SL₂(q) in the one-dimensional case. Thus the codimension of the Schur square determines all transversal logical unitaries. An imported rigidity theorem for stabilizer absolutely maximally entangled states excludes non-Clifford product implementations. For length six, the nonzero-conductor branch is equivalent to the six parity-check points lying on a conic. On a stated regular locus of an explicit non-GRS pencil, a degree-eight invariant classifies the relevant equivalence relations. These geometric applications are independent of the all-length proof.
